description: The signed-in couple's own registry items on Zola, searched by a part of the name, brand, or store, by kind, and by availability. Gives the price, the quantity asked for, bought, and on hold, the group gift progress, and whether guests can buy the item now. For who gave what, use zola_get_my_gift_tracker. Requires Zola sign-in (registry:read).

availability.description: available: guests can buy it now. fulfilled: guests cannot buy it (all bought, on hold, or marked fulfilled). has_purchases: guests bought at least 1 unit or gave to a group gift.

limit.description: The most items to give, 1 to 50. The default is 25.

query.description: A part of the name, brand, or store of the item. Leave it out for every item.

type.description: zola_product, cash_fund, or other_store (an item from another store).

name: zola_search_my_registry_items

outputSchema.description: The items of the wedding registry of the signed-in couple that match the search

exists.description: False when the account has no wedding registry

brand.description: The brand of a Zola product

group_gift.description: Guests give an amount toward the price

marked_fulfilled.description: The couple marked it fulfilled, or Zola locked it

purchased.description: For a group gift, 1 when the goal is reached

reserved.description: In the carts of guests who did not pay yet

store_name.description: The store of an item from another store

links.description: The zola.com pages for this data

matched.description: The items that match, before the limit

truncated.description: True when the limit cut the list

title: Search My Registry
